basics.name: Sebastian Romero Laguna
basics.label: Software Engineer | Full-Stack & Security
basics.summary: Software Engineer with professional experience since 2017, working across full-stack web development, application security, and cloud infrastructure. Holds a Master of Information Technology (Cybersecurity) from CQUniversity, Australia (graduated 2025, GPA 5.786/7.0). Has worked across startup, enterprise, and academic settings in Colombia, the United States, and Australia. Currently a Software Developer (contractor) at PRX Vault, Brisbane, and a part-time Software Engineer at Let's Lyric.

work.name: PRX Vault
work.summary: Full-stack development on a consumer cashback and rewards platform (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Deno Edge Functions).

Software Engineer: Made cashback search 89% faster for members by replacing client-side filtering with ranked PostgreSQL full-text search (BM25-style ranking, GIN index), building the query and view model on the Next.js server, cutting front-end re-renders, and moving infrastructure to a better-placed availability zone; later unified the Wildfire and PokitPal catalogues behind one search RPC.

Designed Baker, an internal automation tool that lets the team record repetitive operational tasks and replay them securely without storing credentials, turning a three-hour manual job into a 15-minute one.

Integrated the PokitPal cashback partner end to end with Supabase Edge Functions (Deno, Hono): two-phase offer catalogue sync, idempotent user provisioning for AU/NZ members, transaction sync, and HubSpot notifications, with zod-validated boundaries and fixture-driven unit tests.
Designed a merchant-to-category many-to-many model with bulk-replace RPCs and canonical category keys, feeding catalogue filters and Customer.io events.

Built the cashback merchant detail page (timeline, tips, exclusions accordion backed by a keyword-scoring heuristic) and hardened signup with country-anchored phone validation, reCAPTCHA host verification, and PII-redacted logs.
Decommissioned the legacy PRX token and giveaway subsystems (Edge Functions, pg_cron jobs, pgmq queues, schema, and UI) through staged, reviewed migrations.
Achieved front-end accessibility compliance across interactive components (keyboard navigation, prefers-reduced-motion, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y).
DevOps: Added Sentry Crons heartbeats to every scheduled Edge Function (Wildfire sync, PokitPal sync, logo sync) and made self-chained batch runs retry, so a single upstream 503 no longer stalls a run.
Scheduled daily merchant-logo reconciliation via pg_cron and an Edge Function, and migrated cashback graphics to Supabase Storage.
Centralised environment-variable handling behind a schema-validated, lazily evaluated accessor shared by all Edge Functions, and enabled Row Level Security on client-facing tables.
Improved mobile performance by converting production images to WebP, splitting bundles with @next/bundle-analyzer, and coalescing concurrent Supabase fetches.
Introduced conditional CI gates and a minimum pull-request test checklist.
Leadership: Conducted a platform security audit identifying vulnerabilities across authentication and data access layers; authored a remediation report and security roadmap presented to engineering leadership.
Authored Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for full-text search, server-resolved merchant logos, and Edge Function standards.
Delivered features under agile methodologies using Jira and Confluence.
Data: Analysed platform data with SQL to explain merchant, category, and offer behaviour to product and leadership, turning questions into decisions on the catalogue and search.

work.name: Let's Lyric
work.summary: Real-time collaborative worship presentation platform (Next.js, Go, Spring Boot, Supabase, Redis, Fly.io).

Software Engineer: Built the Bible module end to end: a Go (Gin) API with multi-version passage lookup, cross-version equivalences, ETag caching and gzip, plus the web reference parser and version picker supporting English and Spanish book names.
Delivered the stage-monitor feature: typed layout contracts, WebSocket transport with inbound reconciliation, a read-only stage route, and a layout editor with aspect-ratio templates.
Shipped the medley editor, song likes, and a first-run onboarding wizard, routing write paths through the catalog API.
Moved song search to a ranked lexical query ordered by title, author, then lyrics.
DevOps: Replaced the multi-step local setup with a one-command Docker Compose environment (self-hosted Supabase, Redis, all services) and a GitHub Actions gate running typecheck, lint, i18n, and tests on every pull request.
Tuned Fly.io deployments (scale-to-zero, gateway header buffers) and gated every analytics provider behind explicit user consent.
Leadership: Reviewed and merged pull requests across the web, infrastructure, and gateway repositories, and recorded Architecture Decision Records for the medley write contract and Bible schedule recovery.
